method.segment: gender=2 (Woman, the supplied label corresponding to Female) AND age_band IN (2,3), labelled 25–34 and 35–49. Missing/refused/unknown on either variable is outside; raw codes, not fuzzy label matching.
method.proportions: 100*sum(w*selected AND eligible)/sum(w*eligible). Unweighted sets w=1. Each result carries raw, weighted and Kish=(sum w)^2/sum(w^2) bases. Binary 0 is a valid nonselection.
method.funnel: All segment members base. Ownership and past-12-month acquisition explicitly labelled; no invented recent-use measure.
method.associations: Segment AND aware of that individual brand. Unaware structural blanks excluded.
method.moments: Both own-brand-aware and all-segment bases supplied and labelled. Link numerator is intersected with each base.
method.media: Past-seven-day use; multiple responses, all segment members; percentages need not sum to 100.
method.category: Repertoire distributions count tracked brands only, excluding Other/None. Decision style uses valid-answer segment base. Acquisition channel uses segment AND last_acquired=1 and valid channel answers.
method.z_test: Independent waves, pooled two-proportion z on Kish effective bases. pooled=(n_eff1*p1+n_eff2*p2)/(n_eff1+n_eff2); SE=sqrt(pooled*(1-pooled)*(1/n_eff1+1/n_eff2)); z=(p2-p1)/SE; two-sided p=erfc(abs(z)/sqrt(2)). Unadjusted, approximate; not complex survey variance.
method.missing: No denominator yields null, never zero; unknown codes do not enter the segment. Synthetic demonstration sample, not real BMW population findings.
